entry.name: jit.phys.multiple
entry.digest: Uses matrices to simulate multiple rigid bodies
entry.description: The jit.phys.multiple object uses several jit.matrix objects to simulate rigid bodies in a physics world. The two outlets connect to the position and rotate matrix inputs of a jit.gl.multiple object allowing for easy visualization of the rigid body shapes.

attributes.name: constraint
attributes.digest: Set and enable the internal constraints
attributes.description: Specifies a constraint type to be used for the internal constraint matrix (default=none). When set, constraints are automatically created halfway between each rigid body and its nearest neighbor, along each dimension of the position matrix.

attributes.name: constraint_matrix
attributes.digest: Enable reporting of constraint positions as a jit_matrix
attributes.description: Enable reporting of constraint positions as a jit_matrix (default = 0)

attributes.name: constraintoutname
attributes.digest: Constraint output matrix name

attributes.name: damping
attributes.digest: Linear and angular damping
attributes.description: Set the linear and angular damping applied to a body in the range 0. to 1. (default 0.2 0.2). Damping can be used to simulate air resistance.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.digest: Enable simulation
attributes.description: Enable bodies in the physics simulation (default = 1).

attributes.name: enable_sleep
attributes.digest: Enable sleeping
attributes.description: Enable sleeping on all bodies, causing deactivation when linear and angular velocity are 0 (default = 0).

attributes.name: filterclass
attributes.digest: Name of this object's collision filter-class.
attributes.description: Set the name of this object's collision filter-class (default = default). Other objects must specify thename in theirlist to enable collisions with this object. Maximum allowed unique names is 10.

attributes.name: filters
attributes.digest: List of filterclass names this object collides with
attributes.description: Specify a list ofnames to enable collisions with (default = all). Possible values include,, and. Additional values include any user-specifiednames (maximum allowed = 10).

attributes.name: force
attributes.digest: Apply force to all bodies
attributes.description: Apply a force to the rigid bodies using a 3D worldspace vector (default = 0 0 0). Ifis enabled, the vector is converted to object space.

attributes.name: forces_relative
attributes.digest: Forces relative flag
attributes.description: Forces relative flag will cause all forces to be converted to object space before applying (default = 0).

attributes.name: friction
attributes.digest: Friction amount
attributes.description: The friction amount (opposite force) (default = 0.5). Applied when the body is in contact with another body that has friction.

attributes.digest: Kinematic flag

attributes.digest: Local scaling flag

attributes.name: mass
attributes.digest: Body mass

messages.name: damping_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the damping parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 2-plane float32 matrix.

messages.description: A named matrix to use for the force parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: friction_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the friction parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 1-plane float32 matrix.

messages.digest: Send modified constraint attributes as a dictionary
messages.description: Send a dictionary description of the modified constraint attributes out the dumpout.

messages.name: impulse
messages.digest: Apply an impulse to all bodies
messages.description: Apply an impulse (instantaneous force) to the rigid bodies using a worldspace vector described by,,. Optional args,,describe a relative position on the body where the force is applied, otherwise it's a central force.
messages.argPattern: x:float, y:float, z:float, relative-x:float?, relative-y:float?, relative-z:float?

messages.name: mass_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the mass parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 1-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: mesh_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the mesh parameter if it's in thelist. Specifies a matrix of vertex values for determining the rigid-body convex hull or concave mesh. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: position_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the position parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: reset
messages.description: Reset all instance body properties, and, and zero all forces.

messages.name: restitution_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the restitution parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 1-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: rotate_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the rotate parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 4-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: rotatexyz_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the rotatexyz parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: scale_matrix
messages.description: A named matrix to use for the scale parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: sendbody
messages.digest: Send a body instance a message
messages.description: Send a body instance a message. If the first arg is a symbol, it's treated as the body instance name. If it's an integer, a list is expected whose length is equal to the number of dimensions of the position-matrix. Possible messages include all values for theattribute (except), as well as theandmessages.

messages.name: sendbody_reset
messages.digest: Send a body instance a message with reset
messages.description: Send a body instance a message with a reset message. See themessage for more info.

messages.name: sendconstraint
messages.digest: Send the internal constraints a message

messages.description: Apply a torque impulse (instantaneous angular force) to the rigid bodies using a worldspace vector described by,,.

messages.description: A named matrix to use for the torque parameter if it's in thelist. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.
